rebuttal_response: P01-QA-002 is resolved: the report now records an executed revert, successful P00 inventory test, byte-exact restoration, and successful post-restoration packaging test. P01-QA-001 and P01-QA-003 are not fully resolved for the reasons below.

findings.title: Several recorded test and rollback commands are still not exact
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3: “It records every prompt TEST with its exact command or inspection procedure, exit status, material output, and a PASS or FAIL conclusion supported by that evidence.”
findings.trigger: A reviewer attempts to reproduce Tests 3–5 or the rollback verification solely from the report.
findings.consequence: Material operations cannot be reproduced exactly, and some claimed checks have no corresponding recorded command and exit status.
findings.evidence: Test 5 uses placeholders including `rsync ... /tmp/p01_ckB/`, `tar -xzf .../distA/*.tar.gz`, `<live-repo>`, and `(same for extractB)`. Section 4 similarly records `/tmp/p01_rollback_backup/...`, `<back to originals>`, and `python3 -c "<sha256 each restored file against pre-rollback digest>"`. Test 3 claims leakage inspection of both archives, but records only the sdist `tar ... | grep` command; the wheel leakage command and the control-build procedure are absent.

findings.title: The checkpoint path inventory and post-change status remain non-exhaustive
findings.criterion_ref: Criteria 2 and 6 require every changed, created, moved, and deleted path to be listed, and require the post-change git status plus reviewable evidence for every deliverable.
findings.trigger: A reviewer attempts to reconstruct the checkpoint delta or compare Section 6 with `git status --short --untracked-files=all`.
findings.consequence: Individual created and moved checkpoint files are hidden behind directory summaries, so the complete mutation set and final working-tree state cannot be audited from the report.
findings.evidence: Sections 2 and 6 collapse `plans_internal/refactor_repo/checkpoints/P01/` and `execution/P01/` into directory entries even though `--untracked-files=all` reports individual files. Current status includes, among others, `checkpoints/P01/deprecated/P01_checkpoint_report.v1.md`, multiple named `QA/rounds/*` files, `QA/session.json`, and three named execution files. The report also says v1 was deprecated but does not explicitly record the move from its former path to `deprecated/P01_checkpoint_report.v1.md`. Its displayed command is labeled “complete, unfiltered” despite collapsing these paths.

observations: The executed rollback evidence substantively resolves the prior rollback finding.
The supplied SHA-256 for `P01_checkpoint_report.v2.md` matches the file on disk.
The report appropriately does not claim that Test 6 or final checkpoint completion has already passed.
reasoning: I compared round history with my own prior verdict and found it accurate. The rollback defect is fixed. Two blocker-level evidence defects remain: placeholder commands defeat the exact-procedure requirement, and directory-level summaries defeat the explicit all-path inventory and complete-status requirements.
